00-thumbnail.png: Illustrated cover: two master VMs and two worker VMs connected on one shared lab platform for Hadoop high availability, Spark, and Hive.
01-architecture.png: Architecture illustration: a single-host, four-VM Hadoop lab with Spark on YARN, active/standby NameNodes, redundant ResourceManagers, Hive, HBase, a three-node ZooKeeper and JournalNode quorum, and three-member MySQL InnoDB Cluster with local Routers.
